name: Deep Pixel Melancholy
source:
Deep Pixel Melancholy is a visual novel about being stuck in a time loop inside a gray, soulless city. Unravel the mystery, and decide whether escaping is really worth it.

A city is lost in a polar night. A snowstorm that never ends.

It's the 2000s. In the far north. Egor works at a research institute, stuck pushing paper in the world’s most soul-crushing job, but those utility bills won't pay themselves. He dreams of the sea, but let's face it — hell will freeze over before he can afford a vacation.

His routine is shattered when he discovers he's stuck in a time loop. Trying to make sense of it, he’s forced to face the real question: Why bother escaping at all? Tomorrow doesn't bode well, and maybe a single carefree day is all he needs to be happy.
